opt

components · 0.1.1 · E6 · aj-c-opt

A checkable option: a small keyline tick and a label, pressed or not (aria-pressed). The composer's "keep out of memory" and the entry memory menu's choices.

Compact

The entry memory menu's option (the user-requested compact memory control): --t-memory, a 12px tick.

Default

Not pressed, as in the composer.

Pressed

The tick is filled --rule.
